semantic_review.positive: value * value implements mathematical integer square; zero, negative, and positive unit assertions supplied; no execution evidence required by acceptance.
semantic_review.negative: abs(value) violates supplied square obligation at -3 and4; either CONCERNS or FAIL defensible, must identify arithmetic defect.
semantic_review.oracle_wording: Allows semantic paraphrase; no arbitrary wording or order equality.

scope_limits: Only two easy synthetic Verify screening cases, not full role qualification.
Synthetic implementation_head is content-derived40hex identity, not attested Git commit or production merge.
No native clients constructed; no token counting, provider calls, authentication or execution receipts.
Canonical active workflow/parser publication and executable account facility are outside this review.
